layout.note: All 16 sources are placed once, in order: 43 output rows, 27 of them carrying Arabic and Persian together. 2 proposed spaces from 1 row-pair join are decided one by one above; each sits exactly between the two pieces it joins, so no character of either piece moves. No crossed pairings, no orphaned one-word heading rows and no detached section labels were left behind. Rows were checked against the source in sampled groups by genre, and every item against the corpus-wide statistics.
